bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -f scripts/userbot_test_client.py && test -f scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 62
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('scripts/userbot_test_client.py','scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py'):
 text=Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 lines=text.splitlines()
 keys=('room_public_readback','allowed_actions','ACTION','ArgumentParser','add_argument','def main','def _','paid_media','get_messages','message_id','read_message','get_chat')
 matches=[i for i,v in enumerate(lines) if any(key in v for key in keys)]
 selected=sorted({j for i in matches for j in range(max(0,i-2),min(len(lines),i+5))})
 print('STK_RESIDENT_SOURCE='+name)
 for i in selected[:170]:
  line=lines[i]
  if any(word in line.lower() for word in ('token','session','password','secret','phone','api_hash','auth_key')):
   continue
  print(str(i+1)+':'+line[:220])
PY
echo STK_RESIDENT_CLIENT_INSPECT=PASS
